item.title: Senior Trump administration officials met to discuss Iran war at Camp David
item.description: Vice President JD Vance, Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth were among the officials who met on Friday to discuss a path forward.

item.title: Brazil presidential election heads to runoff after no majority vote
item.description: Sen. Flávio Bolsonaro, an ally of President Trump and the son of former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro, and Brazil's veteran President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will face off in a runoff on Oct. 25.

item.title: Experts are training AI on how to do their jobs
item.description: It's become a booming industry: teaching artificial intelligence how to get better at doing all kinds of jobs. As AI advances, many fear what this tech means for the future of work.

item.title: Florida GOP governor candidate Byron Donalds courts skeptical Black voters
item.description: Byron Donalds, who could become the first Black Republican elected governor in U.S. history, is looking to win over more Black voters than Trump and DeSantis

item.title: Beavers brought to London to help solve a flooding problem: "They make people smile!"
item.description: London is now home to some wild beavers, the first to live there in 400 years. The critters were brought in to help solve a flooding problem, but now they are a thriving part of the city. Leigh Kiniry has the story.

item.title: New expedition tries to solve Amelia Earhart mystery: "We owe it to Amelia's legacy"
item.description: A new expedition is underway, hoping to solve the mystery of Amelia Earhart's disappearance. Lana Zak reports on the latest clues and details.

item.title: Mortgage rates reach 3-year highs, pushing down housing sales
item.description: Mortgage rates have reached three-year highs, which is pushing down housing sales. Akiko Fujita has more details from Los Angeles.

item.title: CBS News poll finds 66% disapprove of Trump's handling of the economy
item.description: Pressure is building on President Trump to address the cost of living, with Americans frustrated with his handling of the economy and rising prices. A new CBS News poll found that 70% say the president's policies are raising the cost of food and groceries, and 64% said the war in Iran is driving oil and gas prices much higher. Taurean Small has more.

item.title: Cornell president breaks silence: "What happened to Jane Doe in 2024 is deeply disturbing"
item.description: Cornell University's president addressed the school's handling of the alleged gang rape of a junior at a fraternity house in 2024. Lilia Luciano reports from Ithaca, New York.

item.title: 2 dead, dozens injured in Georgia block party shooting
item.description: Two people were killed and another 35 were hospitalized with injuries after a shooting broke out at a neighborhood block party in Georgia, authorities said.

item.title: 2 killed, 35 injured at block party mass shooting in Georgia
item.description: Two men were killed, and 35 people were hurt in a mass shooting in Georgia on Sunday. Police say no arrests have been made so far.

item.title: FlyDubai co-pilot was likely lone wolf, Israeli investigators believe
item.description: The FlyDubai​ alleged attempted hijacking was likely a lone wolf attack, an early investigation by Israel shows, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: U.S. military removes bombers from U.K. air base following security incident
item.description: All U.S. bombers deployed to RAF Fairford have been returned to their home stations in the United States, a Pentagon spokesperson confirmed to CBS News.

item.title: Israel now describes FlyDubai attacker as a "lone wolf" extremist
item.description: The co-pilot suspected of trying to crash flight 1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv was likely not directed by a terrorist group or a nation, Israeli sources told CBS News. For the first time, hero Capt. Smit Machchhar recounts his version of what the United Arab Emirates called a "terrorist act." Matt Gutman reports.

item.title: All B-1 bombers withdrawn from British air base amid Iran-backed threat, spokesperson says
item.description: The U.S. Air Force has rushed to withdraw all twelve B-1 bombers from an air base in Britain, following what the New York Times reports as new threats of an Iran-backed attack against the allied airbase.

item.title: FBI arrests woman accused of surveilling Taiwanese president's son for China
item.description: Wanying "Heather" Zhang, an Irvine, California, realtor, was arrested on a charge of acting as an unregistered agent of a foreign government.

item.title: 60 Minutes Transcript: Artificial intelligence and the future of work
item.description: Some Americans are working to improve artificial intelligence, teaching it the skills and knowledge accrued over the course of a career.

item.title: 60 Minutes Transcript: Sen. Thom Tillis
item.description: Republican Sen. Thom Tillis says he worries about the "outsized influence" of the executive branch. He's also concerned about the types of advisers President Trump has surrounded himself with.

item.title: Sen. Tillis worries about the "outsized influence" of the executive branch
item.description: Republican Sen. Thom Tillis, retiring soon, says without checks on power, U.S. democracy is at risk. He discusses his fears for the future of U.S. democracy and his relationship with President Trump.

item.title: Friars turn to modern technology to repair 13th century basilica
item.description: A team of art historians and software engineers has joined forces with the Franciscan friars to try to complete the restoration of the Basilica of Saint Francis, which was damaged by earthquakes.

item.title: 60 Minutes Transcript: Restoring the Basilica of Saint Francis of Assisi
item.description: Two 1997 earthquakes badly damaged the Basilica of Saint Francis. Friars are partnering with a tech company to restore the church using artificial intelligence and ultra-high-definition photography.

item.title: Gianna Toboni most drawn to "stories that challenge us to hear and understand the other side"
item.description: New 60 Minutes contributor Gianna Toboni is drawn to stories that raise questions for which "there isn't always an easy answer." One is the death penalty, which she has spent a decade covering — and which made headlines this past week after a failed execution attempt in Tennessee.

item.title: Will AI take your job? Or will it transform the way you work? | 60 Minutes
item.description: Some Americans are working to improve artificial intelligence, teaching it the skills and knowledge accrued over the course of a career.

item.title: Sen. Tillis warns that without checks and balances, U.S. democracy is at risk | 60 Minutes
item.description: Sen. Thom Tillis says he has worried about the "outsized influence" of the executive branch for years. He's also deeply concerned about the types of advisors President Trump has surrounded himself with.

item.title: Friars turn to AI for restoration of the Basilica of Saint Francis | 60 Minutes
item.description: Two 1997 earthquakes badly damaged the Basilica of Saint Francis. Friars are partnering with a tech company to restore the church using artificial intelligence and ultra-high-definition photography.

item.title: Zach Bryan wears "Free Palestine" shirt during concerts at Gillette Stadium
item.description: After Macklemore was barred from opening for Ed Sheeran at Gillette Stadium for pro-Palestinian comments, musician Zach Bryan wore a "Free Palestine" shirt during his Friday and Saturday shows.

item.title: 10/4: Who Needs Humans?; The Thom Tillis Tightrope; Saint Francis in the Cloud
item.description: First, Will AI take your job? Or will it transform the way you work? Then, Sen. Tillis warns that without checks and balances, U.S. democracy is at risk. And, restoring the Basilica of Saint Francis.

item.title: 10/4: CBS Weekend News
item.description: U.S. withdraws all B-1 bombers from a British airbase; Israeli soldiers tell CBS News the FlyDubai co-pilot acted alone.

item.title: Trump announces AI "Super Intelligence Force"
item.description: President Trump announced the formation of a "Super Intelligence Force" after meeting with leaders of the country's largest artificial intelligence companies last week.

item.title: U.K.-Iranian national released on bail after arrest in security incident near base
item.description: The 25-year-old man was arrested in London, and police searched two properties in the U.K. capital, Counter Terrorism Policing said.
